title: The Elves and the Shoemaker
moral: When someone helps you, give thanks in return.
notes: 읽어 주기 순서(PLAN §4-2). 이 동화는 놀이와 같은 장면 코드(elves_shoemaker.js)를 읽어 주기에서도 그대로 돌리고 조작만 저절로 한다(T.readPlay 를 쓰지 않음: 녹음 전 줄도 글자를 보이며 끝까지 가게). 이 파일은 장면별 줄 순서 문서이자 시작 화면 읽어 주기 단추 조건(read_script + read_narration)용. 모든 줄이 voice_script 에도 있어 녹음은 같은 클립을 쓴다(src: reuse). 조작 안내(A*)·놀이 전용 정답 반응(S6, W9)·오답(X*)은 빼고 R1~R6 을 넣었다. 끝 교훈 낭독 없음.

lines.text: 눈 내리는 작은 마을에 구두장이가 살았어요. 구두를 아주 잘 만들었지요.
segs: In a little snowy town lived a shoemaker. He made very fine shoes.
lines.en: In a little snowy town lived a shoemaker. He made very fine shoes.

lines.text: 하지만 구두장이는 점점 가난해졌어요. 남은 가죽은 딱 구두 한 켤레 몫이었어요.
segs: But the shoemaker grew poorer and poorer. He had leather left for just one pair of shoes.
lines.en: But the shoemaker grew poorer and poorer. He had leather left for just one pair of shoes.

lines.text: 가죽이 이것뿐이네. 그래도 정성껏 만들어야지.
segs: This is all the leather I have. I will still do my very best.
lines.en: This is all the leather I have. I will still do my very best.

lines.text: 구두장이는 저녁에 가죽을 구두 모양으로 잘라 두었어요.
segs: In the evening, the shoemaker cut the leather into shoe shapes.
lines.en: In the evening, the shoemaker cut the leather into shoe shapes.

lines.text: 내일 아침에 꿰매야겠다. 하암, 졸려.
segs: I will sew them in the morning. Oh, I am sleepy.
lines.en: I will sew them in the morning. Oh, I am sleepy.

lines.text: 구두장이는 마음 편히 잠이 들었어요.
segs: The shoemaker went to bed with a peaceful heart.
lines.en: The shoemaker went to bed with a peaceful heart.

lines.text: 다음 날 아침, 구두장이가 일을 하려고 탁자에 앉았어요.
segs: The next morning, the shoemaker sat down at his table to work.
lines.en: The next morning, the shoemaker sat down at his table to work.

lines.text: 그런데 탁자 위에 구두가 다 만들어져 있었어요!
segs: But the shoes were already finished, right there on the table!
lines.en: But the shoes were already finished, right there on the table!

lines.text: 어? 이게 누구 솜씨지?
lines.en: Huh? Who made these?

lines.text: 구두장이는 구두를 들고 요리조리 살펴보았어요.
segs: The shoemaker picked up the shoes and looked them over, this way and that.
lines.en: The shoemaker picked up the shoes and looked them over, this way and that.

lines.text: 바늘땀 하나 틀린 데가 없어. 정말 멋진 구두야!
segs: Not one stitch is wrong. What wonderful shoes!
lines.en: Not one stitch is wrong. What wonderful shoes!

lines.text: 세상에, 밤새 누가 만들었을까요?
segs: My goodness, who made them in the night?
lines.en: My goodness, who made them in the night?

lines.text: 곧 손님이 가게에 들어왔어요.
segs: Soon a customer came into the shop.
lines.en: Soon a customer came into the shop.

lines.text: 와, 이 구두 좀 봐! 이렇게 고운 구두는 처음이에요.
segs: Oh, look at these shoes! I have never seen such fine ones.
lines.en: Oh, look at these shoes! I have never seen such fine ones.

lines.text: 값을 더 드릴게요. 이 구두는 제가 살게요!
segs: I will pay you extra. These shoes are mine!
lines.en: I will pay you extra. These shoes are mine!

lines.text: 손님은 보통보다 훨씬 많은 돈을 냈어요.
segs: The customer paid much more than usual.
lines.en: The customer paid much more than usual.

lines.text: 이 돈이면 가죽을 두 켤레 몫 살 수 있겠어!
segs: With this money, I can buy leather for two pairs!
lines.en: With this money, I can buy leather for two pairs!

lines.text: 구두장이는 저녁에 가죽 두 켤레 몫을 잘라 두었어요.
segs: That evening, the shoemaker cut leather for two pairs of shoes.
lines.en: That evening, the shoemaker cut leather for two pairs of shoes.

lines.text: 다음 날 아침에도 구두는 다 만들어져 있었어요. 이번엔 두 켤레!
segs: The next morning, the shoes were finished again. This time, two pairs!
lines.en: The next morning, the shoes were finished again. This time, two pairs!

lines.text: 손님들이 또 찾아왔어요.
lines.en: More customers came.

lines.text: 어머, 참 곱네요. 저도 한 켤레 살게요.
segs: Oh my, how lovely. I will take a pair too.
lines.en: Oh my, how lovely. I will take a pair too.

lines.text: 허허, 내 발에 꼭 맞겠구먼.
segs: Ho ho, these will fit my feet just right.
lines.en: Ho ho, these will fit my feet just right.

lines.text: 구두장이는 가죽을 네 켤레 몫 샀어요. 저녁에 자르면, 아침에 다 되어 있었어요. 날마다 날마다요.
segs: The shoemaker bought leather for four pairs. What he cut in the evening was finished in the morning. Day after day after day.
lines.en: The shoemaker bought leather for four pairs. What he cut in the evening was finished in the morning. Day after day after day.

lines.text: 선반에 구두가 가득 찼어요. 그런데 짝이 섞여 버렸네요.
segs: The shelf was full of shoes. But the pairs got all mixed up!
lines.en: The shelf was full of shoes. But the pairs got all mixed up!

lines.text: 구두장이는 섞인 구두를 하나하나 짝 맞춰 선반에 놓았어요.
segs: The shoemaker matched the mixed-up shoes one by one and put them on the shelf.
lines.en: The shoemaker matched the mixed-up shoes one by one and put them on the shelf.

lines.text: 짝을 다 맞췄어. 이제 팔 수 있겠네.
segs: All the pairs are together. Now I can sell them.
lines.en: All the pairs are together. Now I can sell them.

lines.text: 구두장이는 이제 가난하지 않았어요. 넉넉하게 살게 되었지요.
segs: The shoemaker was not poor anymore. He lived comfortably.
lines.en: The shoemaker was not poor anymore. He lived comfortably.

lines.text: 크리스마스가 가까운 어느 저녁이었어요. 창밖에 눈이 펄펄 내렸어요.
segs: It was an evening close to Christmas. Snow was falling softly outside.
lines.en: It was an evening close to Christmas. Snow was falling softly outside.

lines.text: 구두장이는 오늘도 가죽을 잘라 두었어요. 그러다 아내에게 말했어요.
segs: The shoemaker cut his leather as always. Then he said to his wife,
lines.en: The shoemaker cut his leather as always. Then he said to his wife,

lines.text: 여보, 오늘 밤은 자지 말고 지켜보면 어떨까? 누가 우리를 도와주는지 보고 싶어.
segs: Dear, what if we stay up tonight and watch? I want to see who is helping us.
lines.en: Dear, what if we stay up tonight and watch? I want to see who is helping us.

lines.text: 좋아요. 촛불을 켜 두어요.
segs: Good idea. Let's light a candle.
lines.en: Good idea. Let's light a candle.

lines.text: 아내는 초에 불을 붙였어요.
lines.en: The wife lit the candle.

lines.text: 촛불이 켜졌어요. 두 사람은 벽에 걸린 옷 뒤에 숨어서 기다렸어요.
segs: The candle glowed. The two of them hid behind the clothes hanging on the wall and waited.
lines.en: The candle glowed. The two of them hid behind the clothes hanging on the wall and waited.

lines.text: 쉿, 조용히요.
lines.en: Shh, be quiet.

lines.text: 밤 열두 시, 시계가 땡 울렸어요.
segs: At midnight, the clock went dong.
lines.en: At midnight, the clock went dong.

lines.text: 그때, 작은 요정 둘이 쪼르르 들어왔어요. 다 해진 누더기 한 장만 걸치고 있었어요.
segs: Then two tiny elves scurried in. They wore nothing but a ragged old cloth.
lines.en: Then two tiny elves scurried in. They wore nothing but a ragged old cloth.

lines.text: 요정들은 탁자에 폴짝 올라앉아, 잘라 둔 가죽을 집었어요.
segs: The elves hopped up onto the table and picked up the cut leather.
lines.en: The elves hopped up onto the table and picked up the cut leather.

lines.text: 작은 손가락으로 바느질을 하고, 망치로 땅땅 두드렸어요. 어찌나 빠른지!
segs: With their tiny fingers they stitched and sewed, and tap, tap, tapped with a hammer. So fast!
lines.en: With their tiny fingers they stitched and sewed, and tap, tap, tapped with a hammer. So fast!

lines.text: 저렇게 작은 손으로!
lines.en: Such tiny hands!

lines.text: 쉿, 보기만 해요.
lines.en: Shh, just watch.

lines.text: 요정들은 구두를 다 만들어 탁자에 세워 두고는, 후다닥 달려 나갔어요.
segs: The elves finished all the shoes, set them on the table, and dashed away.
lines.en: The elves finished all the shoes, set them on the table, and dashed away.

lines.text: 다음 날 아침, 아내가 말했어요.
segs: The next morning, the wife said,
lines.en: The next morning, the wife said,

lines.text: 그 작은 요정들이 우리를 잘살게 해 주었어요.
segs: Those little elves have made us rich.
lines.en: Those little elves have made us rich.

lines.text: 그런데 입은 게 다 해진 누더기였어요. 얼마나 춥겠어요.
segs: But they wear nothing but rags. They must be so cold.
lines.en: But they wear nothing but rags. They must be so cold.

lines.text: 내가 작은 셔츠와 웃옷, 조끼, 바지와 치마를 지을게요. 양말도 짤게요.
segs: I will sew them little shirts, coats, vests, trousers, and a skirt. And I will knit them socks.
lines.en: I will sew them little shirts, coats, vests, trousers, and a skirt. And I will knit them socks.

lines.text: 당신은 작은 구두를 한 켤레씩 만들어 주세요.
segs: And you make each of them a pair of little shoes.
lines.en: And you make each of them a pair of little shoes.

lines.text: 좋지! 고마운 마음을 꼭 갚아야지.
segs: Gladly! We must give thanks for their kindness.
lines.en: Gladly! We must give thanks for their kindness.

lines.text: 아내는 바느질을 시작했어요. 똑딱똑딱, 뜨개바늘도 바빴어요.
segs: The wife began to sew. Tick, tock, her knitting needles were busy too.
lines.en: The wife began to sew. Tick, tock, her knitting needles were busy too.

lines.text: 아내는 가장 작은 셔츠와 가장 작은 양말을 골라 요정 몫으로 두었어요.
segs: The wife picked the smallest shirt and the smallest sock for the elves.
lines.en: The wife picked the smallest shirt and the smallest sock for the elves.

lines.text: 좋아요. 작은 발에 꼭 맞겠어요.
segs: Good. That will fit a tiny foot just right.
lines.en: Good. That will fit a tiny foot just right.

lines.text: 구두장이도 작은 가죽을 잘라 작은 구두를 만들었어요.
segs: The shoemaker cut small leather and made tiny shoes.
lines.en: The shoemaker cut small leather and made tiny shoes.

lines.text: 구두장이는 작은 망치로 땅, 땅, 땅 두드려 작은 구두를 만들었어요.
segs: The shoemaker tapped with his little hammer, tap, tap, tap, and made tiny shoes.
lines.en: The shoemaker tapped with his little hammer, tap, tap, tap, and made tiny shoes.

lines.text: 땅, 땅, 땅! 세상에서 가장 작은 구두 완성!
segs: Tap, tap, tap! The tiniest shoes in the whole world, done!
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap! The tiniest shoes in the whole world, done!

lines.text: 저녁이 되자 선물이 모두 준비되었어요.
segs: By evening, all the presents were ready.
lines.en: By evening, all the presents were ready.

lines.text: 두 사람은 가죽 대신 작은 옷과 구두를 탁자에 가지런히 놓았어요.
segs: Instead of leather, the two of them laid the little clothes and shoes neatly on the table.
lines.en: Instead of leather, the two of them laid the little clothes and shoes neatly on the table.

lines.text: 요정들이 좋아하면 좋겠다.
segs: I hope the elves like them.
lines.en: I hope the elves like them.

lines.text: 자, 우리는 다시 숨어요.
lines.en: Now, let's hide again.

lines.text: 촛불을 켜고, 둘은 옷 뒤에 숨어 기다렸어요.
segs: They lit the candle, hid behind the clothes, and waited.
lines.en: They lit the candle, hid behind the clothes, and waited.

lines.text: 밤 열두 시. 요정들이 폴짝폴짝 뛰어 들어왔어요.
segs: Midnight. The elves came hopping in.
lines.en: Midnight. The elves came hopping in.

lines.text: 일을 하려고 탁자를 보았는데, 가죽이 없었어요. 대신 예쁜 작은 옷이 놓여 있었지요.
segs: They looked at the table to start work, but there was no leather. Instead, there were pretty little clothes.
lines.en: They looked at the table to start work, but there was no leather. Instead, there were pretty little clothes.

lines.text: 어? 가죽이 없네?
lines.en: Huh? Where is the leather?

lines.text: 이게 뭐지? 작은 옷이잖아!
lines.en: What is this? Little clothes!

lines.text: 요정들은 처음엔 깜짝 놀랐어요. 그다음엔 활짝 웃었지요.
segs: At first the elves were surprised. Then they smiled wide.
lines.en: At first the elves were surprised. Then they smiled wide.

lines.text: 요정들은 너무 기뻐서 폴짝폴짝 뛰었어요.
segs: The elves were so happy, they jumped and jumped.
lines.en: The elves were so happy, they jumped and jumped.

lines.text: 요정들은 후다닥 옷을 입고, 옷매무새를 매만졌어요.
segs: They quickly put on the clothes and smoothed them down.
lines.en: They quickly put on the clothes and smoothed them down.

lines.text: 그러고는 신이 나서 노래했어요.
lines.en: Then they sang with joy.

lines.text: 우리는 멋쟁이, 반짝반짝 새 옷! 이제 구두는 안 만들래!
segs: Look at us, so smart and new! No more shoes for us to do!
Look at us, so smart and new! No more shoes for us to do!
lines.en: Look at us, so smart and new! No more shoes for us to do!

lines.text: 요정들은 춤을 추었어요. 의자를 넘고, 긴 걸상을 넘고, 폴짝폴짝!
segs: The elves danced. Over the chair, over the bench, hop, hop, hop!
lines.en: The elves danced. Over the chair, over the bench, hop, hop, hop!

lines.text: 야호!
lines.en: Hooray!

lines.text: 그러고는 춤을 추며 문 밖으로 나갔어요. 눈 내리는 밤 속으로요.
segs: Then they danced right out the door, into the snowy night.
lines.en: Then they danced right out the door, into the snowy night.

lines.text: 잘 가, 작은 요정들아. 고마웠어.
lines.en: Goodbye, little elves. Thank you.

lines.text: 따뜻하게 지내렴.
lines.en: Stay warm!

lines.text: 그 뒤로 요정들은 다시 오지 않았어요.
segs: After that, the elves never came back.
lines.en: After that, the elves never came back.

lines.text: 하지만 구두장이는 오래오래 잘 살았어요. 하는 일마다 잘되었지요.
segs: But the shoemaker lived happily for a long, long time. Everything he did went well.
lines.en: But the shoemaker lived happily for a long, long time. Everything he did went well.

lines.text: 크리스마스 아침이에요. 가게 창문에 따뜻한 불이 켜졌어요.
segs: It is Christmas morning. A warm light glows in the shop window.
lines.en: It is Christmas morning. A warm light glows in the shop window.

lines.text: 구두장이와 아내가 창가에서 손을 흔들어요.
segs: The shoemaker and his wife wave from the window.
lines.en: The shoemaker and his wife wave from the window.

lines.text: 메리 크리스마스!
lines.en: Merry Christmas!

lines.text: 따뜻한 크리스마스 보내세요!
segs: Have a warm and happy Christmas!
lines.en: Have a warm and happy Christmas!
